metadata.name: MCA Research Benchmark Dataset for AI-Powered Resume Screening
metadata.description: Standardized evaluation queries (job descriptions) and candidate resumes with ground-truth relevance labels for comparing Keyword matching, TF-IDF, and Sentence-BERT semantic models.
metadata.dataset_type: Synthetic benchmark with expert-annotated ground-truth relevance labels

relevance_scale.1: Partially relevant / junior candidate or missing key skills

benchmark_queries.title: Senior Python Backend Engineer
benchmark_queries.description: Seeking an experienced Senior Python Backend Engineer to build high-scale REST APIs, microservices, and database systems. Required skills: Python, Flask, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, Redis. Experience with AWS cloud deployments, CI/CD pipelines, and microservice architectures required. Minimum 4 years experience.

candidates.text: Senior Python Developer with 5 years experience in building microservices using Python, Flask, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL. Proficient with Docker containerization, Redis caching, AWS cloud deployment, CI/CD, and Git. Successfully scaled distributed backend systems.
Full Stack Developer with 3 years experience. Skilled in Python, Django, MySQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Docker. Experience developing REST APIs and integrating databases. Basic knowledge of AWS.
Frontend Specialist with 4 years experience in React, TypeScript, Redux, Tailwind CSS, and Next.js. Built interactive responsive user interfaces. Minor exposure to Python scripting.
Lead Backend Architect with 7 years of Python experience. Master of Flask, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, Redis, Kubernetes, Kafka, and AWS. Architected microservices serving millions of requests.
Junior Python programmer with 1 year experience in Flask and SQLite. Built college projects and personal portfolio websites. Knowledge of Git and Linux basics.

benchmark_queries.title: Machine Learning & NLP Engineer
benchmark_queries.description: Looking for a Machine Learning Engineer specializing in Natural Language Processing and deep learning. Required skills: Python, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, NLP, Hugging Face, Transformers, Sentence Transformers. Experience with text classification, embeddings, and vector databases.

candidates.text: Research Scientist & NLP Engineer with 4 years research experience. Expert in Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face transformers, BERT, text embeddings, and Scikit-learn. Published papers on semantic similarity.
Data Analyst with 2 years experience in Python, Pandas, NumPy, SQL, Excel, and Tableau. Built predictive regression models using Scikit-learn. Basic NLP text preprocessing experience.
iOS App Developer with 3 years experience in Swift, SwiftUI, Objective-C, and Xcode. Built mobile apps for App Store. No machine learning experience.
AI Engineer skilled in PyTorch, TensorFlow, NLP, Scikit-learn, Large Language Models, and vector databases. Implemented semantic search engines and embedding pipelines using Sentence Transformers.
